name: knowbase
architecture: hexagonal (ports & adapters): domain use-cases depend only on Protocol ports; adapters injected by a composition root; sqlite persistence behind a forward-migration runner
interface: stdlib http.server JSON microservice under /api/v1 (ingest/ask/eval/compare/config/adapters) with unversioned /health, /ready and /metrics, plus a typed Python client SDK
testing: port contract test batteries executed against every adapter of every port, plus HTTP integration, adversarial-input, concurrency and migration tests, and a domain-purity fitness function
